ActorTalk: Since the academic affairs system is down, let's use this chance to go apply for the house system to be restored at the Integrated Strategic Studies Department. I really want to participate in the inter-house combat exercises!

This isn't something that can be restored just because you want it to be. Don't you remember that time when a professor publicly criticized the house system in class, saying it caused internal division and conflict within the school? There must be a reason why this educational reform was terminated.

I wrote to the principal before, but got no response. This time I'm going to make a joint petition! Since those famous alumni are here, I hope Gray Raven Commandant, Senior Vanessa, and Senior Simon will sign for me too...
